title: Claude AI's Watermark and How it Really Works
description:
Stop trying to bypass AI content detection with simple rephrasing.

Most people think manual editing fools AI detectors, but algorithms are smarter than that. This breakdown explains exactly how these systems flag machine-generated text and why standard workarounds consistently fail.

Watch to understand the reality of AI detection tools so you can write more effectively.
